title: Do Construction Firms Still Need a Capability Certificate in 2026?
desc: From 1 July 2026, construction firms self-publish their capability instead of holding certificates. Where, what to include, fines, and checking a contractor.
summary: The Construction Law 2025 and Decree 212/2026/ND-CP replace organizational capability certificates with self-disclosure of capability on csdlhdxd.gov.vn; this article explains how homeowners can check a contractor.
body: p

In the past, many homeowners were told to choose a company with a "construction activity capability certificate". From 1 July 2026, under the Construction Law 2025 and Decree 212/2026/ND-CP, the way organizations' capability is managed has changed.
h2
1. Organizations self-publish their capability
p

Under Article 88 of the Construction Law 2025, practicing certificates apply only to individuals holding certain positions. For organizations, the Law provides that organizations participating in construction activities self-publish information on their capability on the website of the Ministry of Construction; this information is a reference basis for investors when selecting contractors (Clause 6, Article 88).
p

The Law also provides that the investor is responsible for the selection of the organizations and individuals it chooses to take part in construction activities (Clause 5, Article 88). In other words, there is no longer a "paper" issued by the State that ranks every company in advance; homeowners must check the contractor carefully themselves, based on the published information, each person's practicing certificate, and actual experience. Individuals holding positions such as design lead and construction supervisor must still hold the corresponding practicing certificate (Clause 1, Article 88).
h2
2. Where is it published, and what does it include?
p
Under Article 41 of Decree 212/2026/ND-CP, organizations self-publish at csdlhdxd.gov.vn, including:
ul
The organization's name and head office address.
The legal representative: full name, position, and phone number.
The enterprise code or decision of establishment.
Construction capability taken from the Construction Activity Information System.
The class and field under any capability certificate previously issued (if any).
p
The legal representative is fully responsible for the accuracy and honesty of the information; every update and correction is logged on the site.
h2
3. What happens to a contractor that does not publish?
p
Under Clause 2, Article 13 of Decree 339/2026/ND-CP, a contractor is fined VND 20–40 million if it:
ul
Fails to publish information on its construction capability as required; or
Assigns people who do not meet the capability requirements to positions as required.
p

This is accompanied by suspension of construction activity for 1 to 3 months and a requirement to publish the information. A foreign contractor must hold a construction activity license (Clause 3, Article 88); otherwise it is fined VND 50–70 million (Clause 3, Article 13 of Decree 339/2026/ND-CP).
h2
4. How can a homeowner check a contractor?
ol
Look up the company name on csdlhdxd.gov.vn and compare the enterprise code and legal representative with the contract.
Ask for the names of the design lead and supervisor; check that their individual practicing certificates match the field and grade (Article 27).
For the site manager, check experience under Article 38.
State the key personnel and equipment in the contract; the investor has the right to check actual capability against the contract (Point a, Clause 1, Article 20 of Decree 207/2026/ND-CP).
p

For a detached house, the homeowner must not allow people who lack the required expertise or experience to carry out design, construction, or supervision where the law requires it (Point c, Clause 2, Article 22). See also Conditions for starting construction of a house 2026.
note

This article is a summary for reference only and does not replace legal documents. From 20 May 2026 to the end of 28 February 2027, Resolution 66.18/2026/NQ-CP on reducing business conditions affects Clauses 1 and 2, Article 88 of the Construction Law; our library does not yet contain the full text of this resolution. From 1 March 2027, Clauses 1 and 2, Article 88 are amended by Law No. 24/2026/QH16 (not yet in force).
